> [!IMPORTANT]
> If you do not use one of these templates, your PR will be closed without review.

# Select a Template

- [Test Day](?expand=1&template=test_day.md): Once integation testing is complete, merge your test branch into main with this template
- [Software Feature](?expand=1&template=software_feature.md): Use this template when merging a software feature into main (including documentation only changes)
- [PCB Feature](?expand=1&template=pcb_feature.md): Use this template when merging a PCB feature into main


> [!TIP]
> If the links seem to not redirect you, it is probably because you have accidentally edited this template.
> In this case you may need to manually append `?expand=1&template=<template_name>` to the end of the URL in your browser. Currently our templates are: `test_day.md`, `software_feature.md`, and `pcb_feature.md`.
> Alternatively, you can also use the `gh` cli to specify a template: `gh pr create --template <template_name>`
